commonPrompt: Original dark-medieval industrial fantasy inside a broken furnace-city: wiry adult forge goblins with rust-red soot-stained skin, long angular ears and pale ember eyes; black iron, cracked ceramic kilns, chains, rivets, oxidized copper, ember-orange furnace light and soot haze. Painterly dark-fantasy realism resembling an early-2000s PC strategy/card game, tactile materials, strong silhouettes and one readable mechanical idea per image. No card frame, text, logos, trademarks, watermark, gore, existing franchise or named-artist imitation. Non-token art is landscape for a card-art window; the token source is a strict portrait 2:3 full-body composition.

assets.prompt: A forge crier opens a furnace gate and shouts through a metal horn as a wave of heat visibly drives the surrounding goblin crew forward, communicating a temporary group attack bonus.
One goblin crew boss arrives with exactly two smaller assistants and a shared tool chest, clearly visualizing an entry effect that creates two basic runners.
A 2/2 goblin marshal opens a side hatch for one attacking runner while synchronized pile drivers strike once for every arriving crew member.

Varka, an adult female forge-goblin with a broken left ear, spins two burning chains into one precise ring that reaches every surrounding target; balanced 3/3 posture, Reflex speed and clear Chronicle leadership.
A siren agitator releases exactly one fresh runner through a gate while the answering crowd visibly increases the agitator's force.
A blast gate bursts open to reveal both incoming reinforcements and a violent pressure wave, expressing the spell's two outcomes: another reveal when empty or an offensive surge for an existing army.
Strict vertical 2:3 full-art portrait of one modest forge runner carrying ember tongs and a scrap-metal buckler; full body, agile silhouette and light equipment communicate a basic 1/1 token.
A broad forge armorer rivets salvaged plates onto other goblins around the workbench, making the +1/+1 benefit to allies visually explicit.
A monumental suspended shift hammer strikes the central anvil and sends pressure rings through goblin ranks, making the whole formation require multiple defenders; persistent Support, not a creature.
A sturdy 2/3 foreman uses a tally wheel and scaled ember projector while fastening fresh armor onto arriving workers, combining an ally aura with entry damage based on the turn's arrivals.
Brakka hammers a new tally plate onto her own armor while attacking; each added plate draws a visibly larger formation of recruits behind her.
Exactly three ordinary forge goblins carry one heavy anvil together, a straightforward collective 3/3 with no magical effect or special ability.
A goblin gunner catches one glowing rivet from a falling ally and immediately fires it toward one uncertain enemy silhouette, communicating a separate random hit for every death.
Many visibly weak goblin attackers sling individual hot rivets that converge into one compact airborne volley, explaining one damage contribution from each small attacker.
A fragile goblin signaler feeds a fallen worker's blank shift plate into a soot-black conveyor that calls the next crew member from the Archive.
One goblin foreman operates a bank of levers while exactly three separate furnaces release exactly three basic runners.
